senses.gloss:
भीरु भी + रु,
 I. adj., f. रु or रू, Timid, Pañc. iii. d. 25.
 II. m.
 1. A jackal.
 2. A tiger.
 III. f. रु or रू.
 1. A timid woman, Vikr. d. 5.
 2. A plant, Asparagus racemosa.
 3. A sort of prickly nightshade.
 4. A centipede.
 5. A goat.
 --Comp.

भीरुक भीरु + क,
 I. adj.
 1. Afraid, Śāk. 30, 6 (Prākṛ.).
 2. Timid, a coward, Hit. iv. d. 30.
 3. Formidable.
 II. m. An owl.
भीरुता भीरु + ता, f. Fear, timidity. Hit. i. d. 118, M.M.; Vikr. d. 102.

भीरुत्व भीरु + त्व, n.
 1. Fear, timidity, Pañc. i. d. 118; 205.
 2. The nature of a tiger, Pañc. i. d. 205 (at the same time in the first signification).
भीरुमय भीरु + मय, adj., f. यि, Terrible, Hit. 116, 8.
भीरु- + हृदय भीरु- + हृदय, m. a deer.
